lessons_learned: NestJS lifecycle: constructor validation runs BEFORE onModuleInit — never validate DI state in constructors, use OnApplicationBootstrap (pitfall #64)
better-sqlite3 nvm vs system node mismatch — always rebuild with the SAME binary the backend runs under (pitfall #52)
Flutter Web URL-as-initial-route can shadow Consumer-based home — always set initialRoute: '/' (pitfall #53)
Provider notifyListeners() must run before await chains, not after (pitfall #42)
Content entity field names are strict — uuid required, ageGroup→ageRange, summary→subtitle (pitfall #11)
JWT query param token needed for Flutter Web <video> elements — httpHeaders ignored on Web (pitfall #62)
Remotion CLI entry point is remotion-cli.js, NOT dist/index.js which only exports (pitfall #70)
Always check ALL entry points when fixing auth/navigation — grep across entire lib/ directory (pitfall #21)

bcrypt.compare in Jest tests: use jest.mock('bcrypt') at module level, NOT jest.spyOn(bcrypt, 'compare') — the latter fails with 'Cannot redefine property' because bcrypt's compare is non-configurable. Always mock the entire module with jest.mock().
SSE streaming: orchestrator must persistMessage BEFORE yield event — SSE controller terminates generator after 'done', code after yield never runs (commit 0024c5b)
SSE streaming: finalContent must use += not = — was overwriting instead of appending token chunks (commit 0024c5b)
Dio Web adapter (XMLHttpRequest) cannot do true SSE streaming — use browser fetch + ReadableStream.getReader() on Web platform (sse_adapter.dart pattern)
When refactoring to extract a module (e.g. SSE parsing → sse_adapter.dart), check if the original file still needs its now-unused imports (e.g. dart:convert in api_service.dart)
Coordinated mode streaming: runLoopStream's 'done' event must be filtered inside runCoordinatedFlowStream — only emit the final done, not the inner agent's done

generateQuiz tool handling: agent-executor must emit game_data for both generateActivity AND generateQuiz — previously generateQuiz game_data was silently dropped, meaning quiz content from generateQuiz never reached the frontend (commit 36b4faf)

Flutter game rendering: unify all game types through _InlineGameCard with _inferActivityType — don't special-case quiz via _parseQuizFromAIResponse, let GameRenderer handle all types including quiz (commit 36b4faf)
React SSE parsing: parse complete event blocks delimited by \n\n, NOT line-by-line — line-by-line breaks on multi-line data payloads and CRLF endings (commit 36b4faf)
Flutter use_build_context_synchronously: capture context.read references BEFORE await calls — using mounted ? context.read<T>() : null pattern satisfies the analyzer and is semantically correct

Jest testing agent-executor: ContentSafetyService mock must include filterContent() (not just isContentSafe) — the executeStream method calls this.contentSafetyService.filterContent() on the final response. Mock returns { content, wasFiltered: false }.

ESLint v10 flat config: when installing typescript-eslint + react-hooks plugins for React 19, some rules (set-state-in-effect, preserve-caught-error) are new in v10 and may flag existing code as errors — downgrade to 'warn' to avoid blocking builds while issues are addressed gradually

Frontend-web ESLint: the 'lint' npm script was misconfigured as 'tsc --noEmit' (typecheck) instead of actual eslint. When adding flat config, also update package.json scripts: lint='eslint src/', lint:fix='eslint src/ --fix', keep typecheck separate

React rules-of-hooks: when a component has a conditional early return (e.g. `if (sceneDocument) return <Component />`), ALL hooks must be placed BEFORE the conditional — not just the ones that are always called. Moving useState above the early return is the correct fix, not wrapping in a conditional hook.

ESLint @typescript-eslint/ban-ts-comment: @ts-expect-error directives require a description of at least 3 characters after the directive (e.g. `// @ts-expect-error - reason here`). Without a description, it triggers an error. Always add a description when converting from @ts-ignore.
